title: The Lease Clause That Pushed Sam Walton Out of Newport
conflicts: Sales figures differ: Tedlow (HBS, 2001) gives $72,000 before Walton to about $250,000 in his fifth year; the Encyclopedia of Arkansas gives $80,000 to $225,000 in three years; the story says only 'roughly tripled'. Some popular accounts invert the $50,000 sale; Tedlow's text says Holmes bought the fixtures and inventory from Walton, which the story follows and attributes to Walton's memoir.
notes: Made in America is not freely available online, so Walton's memoir words are quoted as reproduced in Tedlow's HBS Working Knowledge excerpt and attributed to Walton.
